component.name: Patrone File Manager
component.summary: Browse and manage files the way Windows users expect

description.p: Patrone File Manager works the way people who have used Windows expect, with the layout, menus and keys they know.

ul.li: Tabs, the command bar, breadcrumbs and the navigation pane, with Quick access, Home, Gallery and Computer
Eight views, and the details and preview panes
Full right-click menus, Folder Options and Properties
Copying, moving and deleting with progress, conflict handling and undo
The Recycle Bin, removable drives, mapped network drives and network places

description.p: Patrone File Manager as a Flatpak, for any Linux, with the computer's files, programs and apps.
